card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as a population count, study enrollment figure, law number or page range. It is usually the second or third digit, with more digits still to come.

modes.label: Population and enrollment counts
modes.description: A digit inside a comma-separated count of people, like a county census or a study group size.
